text: In synthetic homotopy theory, the statement π₁(S¹) = ℤ is proved by:
choices: Seifert-van Kampen applied to two arcs
the encode-decode method using the winding number code family
explanation: π₁(S¹)=ℤ in HoTT: define code:S¹→U with code(base)=ℤ, code(loop)=ua(succ). The encode function uses transport; decode sends n:ℤ to loopⁿ. Show encode∘decode=id and decode∘encode=id.
